notes: Seven own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin (home, pricing, HVAC and plumbing industry pages, integrations, the Plumbing Package help article on help.housecallpro.com, and the AI guidance page /llm-info/). The canonical home https://housecallpro.com/ resolves to www.housecallpro.com, which was read. Prices were classed against the pricing and AI guidance pages (Basic $79 monthly or $59 annual for 1 user; Essentials $189 or $149 for 5 users; MAX $329 or $299 for 8 users, $35 per additional user). The HVAC and plumbing packages carry their own prices (Essentials $299 for 5 users, MAX $649 for 8 users, $100 or $75 per additional user), which is why C09 and C10 are true alongside the standard prices. C11 ($65 starting price) is classed wrong: no published plan is $65 on either billing basis. Cause trace for C11 read three of the answer's cited pages: fieldservicesoftware.io (200; its $65 figure belongs to RazorSync and it gives Housecall Pro's Basic correctly), bdrco.com (HTTP 403, blocked) and founding.dev (200, no price); the cited Reddit thread is disallowed by robots.txt and was not fetched, so the cause is not found; a person could read the bdrco.com and Reddit pages in a browser. Starting prices without a billing basis were grouped with the matching Basic price ($59 annual or $79 monthly). Hedged lines (can require, may lack) and review ratings, review-sentiment percentages and capability claims (route optimization, marketing automation) were not coded. Generic mobile-app statements were coded under platforms (C47). Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked own page. Consistency check: C11 ($65 starting price) moved from wrong to unverifiable, because the answer gives an approximate figure with no billing basis that falls between the published $59 annual and $79 monthly entry prices. Completeness: six instances added to existing claims (C03, C15, C19, C42, C44) and seven claims added (C50 to C56) from table cells and lines under vendor sub-headings, including the 14-day trial, payment processing fees, paid add-ons, the Plumbing Package bundle and a Reece integration (unverifiable).
